findings.conclusion: Read the actual frozen 39590-byte D2 preparer and its sealed input/closure/candidate originals. The consumer's preparation field names, original qualification command, successful closure report, four-field candidate_patch identity including computed Git blob, source-before/source-after and original Q report identity match the producer's actual source shape.

The frozen candidate has 222 baseline and 222 candidate inputs, exactly phase_cost.rs and ssh_observation_profile.rs changed, no additions, and unchanged Cargo.toml. The binder compares preformat input to preparation/source_input and final formatter-tested map to preparation/source_tested/source_after/source-map plus current source bytes. It also rebinds the unchanged qualified D1 baseline source.

Original eight stage names/order, nineteen harness hashes, all-features/offline/locked checks on clippy/test-build/release, zero retry and dynamic summary/audit reconciliation remain. It does not substitute a predicted D1 count for future D2 counts. All native read pages retain original bytes, contiguous offsets, EOF and durable terminal binding.

Fifteen fixed preparation identity entries exactly match the published deployment catalog. Twenty-seven owner identity entries, old job IDs and two permanently missing original D1 paths exactly match the actual frozen closure JSON. The binder rereads those bound originals and matches the successful preparation's recorded closure; it does not replay the pre-rename cache validator, old auditor or workload.

The post-rename check binds the D2 target location and old D1 cache absence, original single rename/no-copy/no-deletion facts, retained six release copies and the preserved original test-custody receipt. It does not introduce a new live whole-machine-idle claim or reread huge retained test ELFs.

Q-only and full proofs bind the foundation's exact canonical module pin. The actual executing copy is read through the stable reader and must have identical raw bytes to the canonical source, but may reside in the sealer preparation directory or C1 tools copy. Returned proof identity is canonical, avoiding execution-copy-path differences or rewriting a historical CI plan.

CI command matrix, environment, nextest 0.9.137 binary/receipt, canonical workflow and private source workflow are exact D1 facts with only the D2 ROOT path changed. The full CI consumer still binds six original stage logs, child/process-group closure, complete inventory/case hashes, Q counts, zero retry and no hosted-Actions success claim.

The external R25 CI manifest is a single explicit path/45857-byte/SHA binding using bf0df5f7d19ebd149854fbf75887fb0fb136f18a63a0c240abf8420655fb195e. Generic _declared allowed roots remain byte-identical. The canonical D2 module identity must appear among actual CI input bindings.

Twelve generic helper functions are byte-exact D1 reuse, including native_stream_pages required by the ordinary consumer. Draft03 differs from draft02 only by that original function plus its separating newline. Static symbol-table inspection found no remaining unresolved global references.

Q-only requires actual qualification identity/pages and leaves CI conditional; full proof requires a distinct actual CI job and its complete originals. No future native terminal, result count, source map or ELF was filled by this review. Qualification/full foundation generation and CI/ordinary producer modules are separately reviewed inputs.
